a.lede: Leakers have pieced together a playable version of the canceled Portal prequel F-Stop. Most of the assets came from the massive 12-terabyte leak that dropped this August. That didn't include the game's source code or map data, but those final pieces apparently hit the Valve Cut Content Discord this week, allowing a nearly complete version […]
a.title: A fully playable version of Portal prequel F-Stop leaked

b.lede: This rough version is the closest thing to a release we'll see.
